mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a quarter signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over a quarter signals increased demand for housing, which boosts the construction sector and related industries, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% over a quarter signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with high borrowing costs, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with high interest rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures rise by more than 1% and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% within a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand and a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
